title: button groups
rule: Present related actions as a small cluster of buttons, aligned horizontally or vertically; split into more groups if there are more than three or four actions.

citation.source: Designing Interfaces 3e ch. Doing Things — Button Groups (Tidwell, Brewer, Valencia)

pass_when: Related actions sit in one small horizontal or vertical cluster; more than three or four are split into further groups.
fail_when: Related actions are scattered, or more than three or four sit in one undifferentiated strip.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
